_how_to_use: One object per tester. Timed A/B sessions fill time_*/score_*/survey; observed sessions leave them out. Then run: python scripts/build_report.py and python scripts/build_slides.py
method: Observed sessions on the author's laptop: the tester used WordWise on their own, the author watched and took notes, then asked for feedback. No timed with/without comparison was run.

testers.what_they_did: Uploaded test PDFs (a course email and readings), used read-aloud and selected passages for “Make it simpler”.
problems: Read-aloud sounded robotic (the browser's default voice was used before its natural voices loaded).
Read-aloud mispronounced words such as past-tense “read”.
Selecting a sentence clipped the first letter (“he exam” instead of “The exam”).
changes: Read-aloud now waits for and ranks the browser's natural voices, with a voice picker.
New Pronunciation Helper agent respells heteronyms for the voice only (“read” → “red”).
Selections now always expand to whole words.

testers.who: Olivia, 23, the author's sister; had reading tutoring in grades 1–5, now a strong reader (chemistry graduate, starting medical school)
testers.what_they_did: Created her own account and explored the Reading Studio and the AI Tutor.
testers.liked: The AI Tutor, as a natural way in for children used to asking Google or AI.
quotes: I thought this was very easy to use for younger kids. I would have used this to practice reading strategies later (and mom would have made/helped me).
Kids nowadays are so used to asking Google or AI things, this would be an easy application to use for them.
problems: All pages looked the same (same book icon and colors), so it was hard to tell at a glance which page she was on.
Observed: she skipped the Learning Tools page that explains each tool and went straight to using the tools.
changes: Each page now has its own school-themed icon and header color, with the same layout.
The tool explanations moved into the Reading Studio as a Quick guide (opens on a first visit); the Tool Guide page moved to the end of the menu.
